newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corinne Bouygues quits top TF1 posts.
newsitem.headline: Corinne Bouygues quits top TF1 posts.

text.p: Corinne Bouygues has resigned from her two managerial posts at private French television station TF1, a TF1 spokesman said on Thursday, confirming press reports.
Bouygues, 49, is a member of the Bouygues family whose building company, Bouygues SA is TF1's biggest shareholder.

She will remain in her posts of managing director of TF1 Publicite, which sells advertising space on TF1, and chairman of TF1 Entreprises, the channel's teleshopping, video and music arm, until the end of July, the TF1 spokesman said. He declined to comment on the reasons for her resignation.
Newspapers Le Figaro and Les Echos said Corinne Bouygues was leaving TF1 for personal reasons.

Les Echos also said Corinne Bouygues appeared to disagree with the approach of TF1 chairman Patrick Le Lay. Her resignation could signify that her brother, Martin Bouygues, chairman of the Bouygues building company, had ruled against her in this conflict.
